knowledge_review_status_change.name: knowledge_review_status_change
knowledge_review_status_change.value: ("knowledge_review"."decision" = 'approve' and "knowledge_review"."from_status" = 'draft' and "knowledge_review"."to_status" = 'reviewed') or ("knowledge_review"."decision" = 'reject' and "knowledge_review"."to_status" = "knowledge_review"."from_status") or ("knowledge_review"."decision" = 'deprecate' and "knowledge_review"."to_status" = 'draft')

interview_turn_answer_length.name: interview_turn_answer_length
interview_turn_answer_length.value: "interview_turn"."answer" is null or char_length("interview_turn"."answer") between 1 and 10000

interview_turn_answer_consistency.name: interview_turn_answer_consistency
interview_turn_answer_consistency.value: ("interview_turn"."status" = 'answered') = ("interview_turn"."answer" is not null and "interview_turn"."answer_submitted_at" is not null)

transcript_confirmed_consistency.name: transcript_confirmed_consistency
transcript_confirmed_consistency.value: ("transcript"."status" = 'confirmed') = ("transcript"."confirmed_text" is not null and "transcript"."confirmed_at" is not null)

skill_observation_mastery_range.name: skill_observation_mastery_range
skill_observation_mastery_range.value: ("skill_observation"."mastery_before" is null or "skill_observation"."mastery_before" between 0 and 1) and ("skill_observation"."mastery_after" is null or "skill_observation"."mastery_after" between 0 and 1)

skill_observation_confidence_range.name: skill_observation_confidence_range
skill_observation_confidence_range.value: ("skill_observation"."confidence_before" is null or "skill_observation"."confidence_before" between 0 and 1) and ("skill_observation"."confidence_after" is null or "skill_observation"."confidence_after" between 0 and 1)

learning_progress_completion_consistency.name: learning_progress_completion_consistency
learning_progress_completion_consistency.value: ("learning_progress"."status" in ('self_reported', 'verified')) = ("learning_progress"."completed_at" is not null and "learning_progress"."evidence_level" is not null)

learning_progress_evidence_level_match.name: learning_progress_evidence_level_match
learning_progress_evidence_level_match.value: ("learning_progress"."status" = 'self_reported' and "learning_progress"."evidence_level" = 'self_reported') or ("learning_progress"."status" = 'verified' and "learning_progress"."evidence_level" = 'verifiable') or ("learning_progress"."status" in ('started', 'abandoned') and "learning_progress"."evidence_level" is null)

performance_pair_eligible_requires_refer.name: performance_pair_eligible_requires_reference
performance_pair_eligible_requires_refer.value: "performance_pair"."eligibility" <> 'eligible' or ("performance_pair"."reference_score" is not null and "performance_pair"."mae" is not null and "performance_pair"."learning_exposure_matched" and "performance_pair"."retest_interview_id" is not null)

eval_experiment_published_requires_appro.name: eval_experiment_published_requires_approval
eval_experiment_published_requires_appro.value: "eval_experiment"."deployment_status" <> 'published' or ("eval_experiment"."approved_at" is not null and "eval_experiment"."approved_by" is not null)

eval_experiment_rollback_consistency.name: eval_experiment_rollback_consistency
eval_experiment_rollback_consistency.value: "eval_experiment"."deployment_status" <> 'rolled_back' or ("eval_experiment"."rolled_back_at" is not null and "eval_experiment"."rollback_reason" is not null)

experiment_case_result_score_range.name: experiment_case_result_score_range
experiment_case_result_score_range.value: ("experiment_case_result"."baseline_score" is null or "experiment_case_result"."baseline_score" between 0 and 1) and ("experiment_case_result"."candidate_score" is null or "experiment_case_result"."candidate_score" between 0 and 1)

experiment_case_result_exclusion_reason.name: experiment_case_result_exclusion_reason
experiment_case_result_exclusion_reason.value: ("experiment_case_result"."excluded" = false and "experiment_case_result"."exclusion_reason" is null) or ("experiment_case_result"."excluded" = true and char_length(btrim("experiment_case_result"."exclusion_reason")) > 0)

policy_champion_rollback_consistency.name: policy_champion_rollback_consistency
policy_champion_rollback_consistency.value: "policy_champion"."rolled_back_at" is null or ("policy_champion"."rollback_reason" is not null and "policy_champion"."previous_policy_version" is not null)

feedback_entry_message_length.name: feedback_entry_message_length
feedback_entry_message_length.value: "feedback_entry"."message" is null or char_length("feedback_entry"."message") between 1 and 2000

metric_snapshot_ratio_ranges.name: metric_snapshot_ratio_ranges
metric_snapshot_ratio_ranges.value: ("metric_snapshot"."run_failure_rate" is null or "metric_snapshot"."run_failure_rate" between 0 and 1) and ("metric_snapshot"."skill_coverage" is null or "metric_snapshot"."skill_coverage" between 0 and 1) and ("metric_snapshot"."repeat_rate" is null or "metric_snapshot"."repeat_rate" between 0 and 1) and ("metric_snapshot"."plan_adherence" is null or "metric_snapshot"."plan_adherence" between 0 and 1)
